_doc: Arc-seconds unless named _deg. Body tolerances apply AFTER correcting for the documented difference between ESHANA's and Swiss Ephemeris's delta-T (future delta-T is a forecast; the two forecasts differ by up to ~200 s by 2140). Measured worst cases are in benchmarks/accuracy/birth-chart-accuracy.md; each tolerance sits above its measured worst case with margin, never at it.
